title: Qaspeq Kuspuk Pattern - PDF Printable - Alaska Native Dress - Adult Atikluk
description:
This is the first Native created Qaspeq Kuspuk pattern on the market. These fit womens sizes XS to 5X but traditionally worn lose and flowy. Qaspeqs are traditional dresses made in Alaska.  This pattern can be made as a vest style when using 1”-1.5” bias tape, whether homemade or bought. *Printing in the margins will vary for each printer so I like to mention to "match the lines" together when placing the pattern together. It may be a bit wonky but has been shown to work. A video tutorial is on it's way!

*Seam allowance FAQ: It is ready to cut without any seam allowance and whatever hip/bust size I need I use the size guide as a literal guide and lay out the fabric to see if it matches the size (inches) needed or size up according to the size guide. Each size for example 2-4 numeral sizes would be XS-S. Or in children’s sizes, 6 months is 6 months without stretch unless you’re using stretch material.


Happy to mention, besides the patterns traded and given throughout our time this pattern was not the first but it is the first Native made Qaspeq online-printable pattern. I couldn’t  have done it without values passed onto me from my Grandma to my Mom. My Grandma’s Mom and hers and so on and all the Aunties who gave me tips (especially when it came to the ruffles and especially my Mother in law). It was meant to be passed on and this is my way of sharing traditional knowledge. Quyana and Love ya’ll.


Principal rule is anyone can create their own qaspeq but only Alaska Natives can sell them along with things like ivory and other indigenous goods.

title: Light Blue Button-Front Collared Housecoat for Elderly People
description:
Silkandmore now makes specialized clothing for seniors.
I did a survey of some of my elderly and disabled customers. Some had issues with arms, some in wheelchairs, some with Rhuematoid arthritis. The overall sense I got was that what was needed was a garment that makes you comfortable, has easy functionality, and all in all makes you FEEL good. So I designed some clothing that would fit the needs of the elderly.

These housecoat combines the ease and coverage of a robe with the style of a caftan. Besides being beautiful and incredibly comfortable this unique garment offers many benefits to our elderly and disabled customers.

Ease of Use - It is so easy to get in and out of. The housecoat has buttons in the front so that it can be stepped in and pulled up or a it can be pulled down over the head for easy and self-dressing. It also features roomy sleeves which are ideal as they make it easy to put on and off.

Construction-The cotton used to make this is very soft, the attention paid to the inside (seams, hems etc.) is identical to the outside. You can wear this around the home, have a guest over or go to the mailbox. While these "feel" as comfortable as a regular robe you will "look" as if you got "dressed" up for the day. These are also ideal for the hospital stay.

Lining- While the cotton used in this is very soft, it's weight and draping provides adequate coverage. Some women may choose to have lining added for extra coverage due to previous surgeries such as mastectomies , -ostomy appliances, etc. This feature is available at an additional charge of $10 for women who want extra coverage
www.etsy.com/listing/214886222/add-lining-to-robes

Pockets-Women who are disabled and need assistive devices such as a cane or have a weakness or disability of the hands/arms need will appreciate the pockets on the housecoat to carry items.

Sizing- The housecoat is made for you based not just on "dress size." when ordering, an additional measurement for height is used for a true fit. This allows for the correct size AND length of your housecoat. For disabled women in wheelchairs or who ride scooter there is sufficient coverage in the skirt area to cover the lap. 

Fabric Pattern - In order to make buying experience simple and easy for my lovely elderly customers, I have put my housecoats color wise. So now you would be able to see all the patters available in one color in one picture itself. So like in the above picture, you will see 6 different patterns available in Light Blue and you can simply select whichever you like. When making the purchase, please refer to the the first picture. You can choose your pattern of choice from among the standing and seated people in that picture.

description:
Inspired by the whitework trousseau nightgowns of the late 1800s, the Lizzie Nightdress brings that quiet, romantic detail into something you can actually sleep in tonight. Victorian women layered fine cotton lawn and cambric nightgowns with pintucked bodices and hand-worked florals — practical, breathable pieces meant for warm nights before electric fans and air conditioning. This design takes that same spirit: a soft, sleeveless cotton nightdress with a pintucked bodice and delicate white daisy embroidery, made for comfort on hot nights and for anyone drawn to an antique, heirloom look.

description:
A graceful full-length nightdress drawing on nightwear held in museum textile collections from the late Victorian and Edwardian periods (c. 1880–1915) — an era when fine cotton lawn nightgowns were embroidered by hand as part of a bride’s trousseau or a lady’s household linen.
Made from exquisite quality 100% cotton, soft, breathable, and finished to drape beautifully from a wide scoop neckline down to a full, flowing hem and two deep hidden pockets. The hem is finished with a scalloped border of elaborate embroidered teardrop motifs, each filled with fine leaf and feather stitching,  a hallmark of the intricate needlework seen on antique nightdresses and christening gowns from this era.
With its soft turquoise embroidery against crisp white cotton, this nightdress makes a beautiful “something blue” for brides — an elegant choice for the night before the wedding, a honeymoon trousseau piece, or a bridal shower gift.
Thoughtfully updated for modern life with two deep hidden pockets set into the side seams — a practical touch rarely found on original antique pieces, added here for everyday ease.

HOW TO CARE FOR LEATHER PRODUCTS

Keep your leather products free from dust by storing in a protective cloth bag.

Do not store in a plastic bag as leather needs to "breath"

Should the product accumulate some dust or debris just wipe with a clean, damp (not wet) cloth.

Never use any soap or detergent to clean the product.

Do not store in direct sunlight or under sharp artificial light.

Avoid storing in a damp closet, environment should be cool but dry.

Do not allow cosmetics, perfumes or hand creams to come in contact with the leather.

Any accidental oil stains should immediately be treated with talcum powder which should absorb the oil and draw most of it out of the product.

Do not over fill your product as leather will stretch, but will not return to its original shape.

Caring for leather products is essential to maintain their appearance and durability. Here are some tips on how to care for leather products:

Storage: Store your leather products in a protective cloth bag to keep them free from dust. Avoid using plastic bags as leather needs to breathe.

Cleaning: If your leather product accumulates dust or debris, wipe it gently with a clean, damp (not wet) cloth. Avoid using soap or detergent, as they can damage the leather.

Sunlight and Artificial Light: Do not store leather products in direct sunlight or under sharp artificial light. Prolonged exposure to light can cause fading and damage to the leather.

Storage Environment: Choose a cool and dry environment for storing leather products. Avoid damp closets or areas with high humidity, as moisture can lead to mold or mildew growth.

Avoid Chemicals: Keep leather products away from cosmetics, perfumes, and hand creams. These products can stain or damage the leather surface.

Handling Oil Stains: If your leather product accidentally gets oil stains, treat them immediately by applying talcum powder. The powder will absorb the oil and help draw it out of the leather.

Avoid Overfilling: Do not overfill your leather product, as leather can stretch but may not return to its original shape. Overfilling can also stress the stitching and cause long-term damage.

Hangers: Avoid using metal hangers for hanging leather jackets or other leather products. Instead, opt for padded or wooden hangers to prevent stretching or distortion.

Drying: If your leather product gets wet, avoid drying it with heat sources like hair dryers or heaters. Let it dry naturally in a well-ventilated area. Excessive heat can cause the leather to become brittle or crack.

By following these care instructions, you can ensure that your leather products remain in good condition, extending their lifespan and maintaining their aesthetic appeal.

Colour blocks that drift gently across your Gigante Cardigan

A digital PDF knitting pattern for a big, oversized chunky cardigan you knit yourself. 📄

🎨 THE COLOURWAY

• The Crossover pattern PDF, instantly. Stitch counts are written out for Regular M

👋 A LITTLE ABOUT ME
I'm Fernando. From my studio in Worthing, on the South Coast of the UK, I'm building Gigante Knits: the tools, patterns and kits for chunky knitting I couldn't find anywhere else. Knitting got me through a difficult stretch, and somewhere along the way I fell in love with how geometric and quietly mathematical it is. I'm Fernando. From my studio in Worthing, on the South Coast of the UK, I'm building Gigante Knits: the tools, patterns and kits for chunky knitting I couldn't find anywhere else. ​🧺 Care Instructions
To preserve the softness and shape of the alpaca, merino, cashmere knit, gentle hand washing or professional dry cleaning is recommended.
Wool fibers have a scale structure, similar to human hair. This makes it difficult for wool to get wet, prevents dirt from sticking to it, and prevents bacteria from multiplying. The very important feature is the so-called self-cleaning of the fibers upon contact with oxygen. Thanks to these features, washing wool clothes is not necessary as often as washing other clothes. It's definitely better to air out natural wool garments frequently (bur not in the sun!) than wash. It might be hard to believe at first but it really works – just try it once and this method of "washing" wool will become your favorite. Eventually, however, there comes a point when you no longer want to just freshen up the clothes, but rather actually wash them or even remove something specific from the surface. Then there's no other way - we have to wash the clothes.
​To keep your wool sweater in its original shape:
​Hand wash in cool water (max. 30°C) using a gentle wool detergent without softeners.
​Lay flat to dry, away from direct sunlight.
​Do not hang, do not tumble dry.

A soft, oversized turtleneck sweater with a beautiful gradient and airy drop‑stitch texture. Hand‑knitted slowly and carefully, it wraps you in warmth and calm — perfect for cosy days, creative mornings, or quiet evenings at home.

You know that feeling when you put on a genuine, handmade piece and instantly feel enveloped in calm? Like the world slows down for a moment, the noise fades, and you just feel... beautifully wrapped.

The modern design is perfectly blended with timeless cosiness, and those subtle drop-stitch openings along with the flowing gradient stripes create a look that is both sophisticated and relaxed. It’s a piece you’ll proudly wear for a coffee date with a friend or during a peaceful day at home. ☕

However, because this is a custom knit pullover made just for you, we can pick the perfect yarn together. You might prefer the extra puszysta softness of a luxury wool blend or perhaps a gentle, wool-free fibre if your skin is very sensitive. The colours are also fully customisable – while this moody gradient is stunning, I can make it in a solid tone or a completely different palette. Just send me a message and we will find exactly what you are looking for.

Since this is a bespoke item made from scratch, stitch by stitch, please allow 4–5 weeks for me to complete your order. I want to make sure every detail is perfect before it reaches you.

When your dream sweater arrives, please treat it with care – I recommend hand washing in cool water or using a gentle wool cycle, and always laying it flat to dry. To keep the fibres beautiful, do not bleach or tumble dry. Because this garment is custom-made specifically for you, I cannot accept returns, but of course, I accept complaints regarding any faults in workmanship. If you are returning an item from outside the UK, please remember to mark the package clearly as "RETURN".

**Care Instructions for Knitted Garments:
1. Fill a basin with cool water (around 30°C) and dissolve a small amount of wool detergent or shampoo.
2. Submerge the knitted garment in the water and let it soak for 5-10 minutes.
3. Carefully squeeze the item several times with your hands, avoiding rubbing.
4. Rinse the garment in water at the same temperature (30°C) until the detergent is completely removed.
5. Gently press out excess water without twisting the garment.
6. Lay the item flat on a dry towel, shaping it as needed and smoothing out any wrinkles. Leave it to dry naturally in this position.
By following these steps, your knitted items will stay in excellent condition.

A Full‑Length Crochet Cardigan That Flows Like a Summer Breeze.

Long enough to feel like a statement. Light enough to forget you’re wearing it.
This isn’t the cropped crochet cardi you toss on and tug down all day. It’s a true maxi length cover‑up that falls to your ankles in a soft, open‑knit floral pattern. The deep V‑neck and wide, flared sleeves add drama without weight, and the front tie closure lets you decide exactly how much shape you want. Throw it over your swimsuit and you’re beach‑royal. Layer it over a camisole and you’re boho‑brunch ready.

The Maxi Fit — Finally, A Crochet Cardigan That Goes All the Way Down:
Bust: 110–120 cm (43–47 in) — designed to drape loosely, not cling.
Sleeve length: 45–52 cm (17.7–20.5 in) — long enough to cover the upper arm, open enough to feel airy.
Total length: 125–135 cm (49–53 in) — that full, sweeping silhouette that photographs like a dream.
The one‑size cut fits most S through L beautifully thanks to the open front and adjustable tie. Model is 164 cm (5′4″) for reference; on someone taller, the hem hits just below the calf; on someone shorter, it pools at the ankle.

Why This One Belongs in Your Summer Wardrobe:
Genuine Crochet Lace: Not printed lace, not woven lace — real hand‑looped knit that stretches slightly and breathes all day.
See‑Through by Design: Meant to be layered over a bikini, a slip dress, or high‑waisted shorts and a bandeau. The floral openwork gives just enough peek‑a‑boo to feel flirty without overexposing.
Quick‑Dry & Packable: The polyester yarn dries fast if you get splashed, wads up small into a beach bag, and shakes out without wrinkles — perfect for travel.
Long Sleeves That Don’t Suffocate: Flared from the elbow down, so the air moves freely. You get the boho sleeve drama without the sauna effect.

Style Combinations That Work:
Beach Look: Over a neutral bikini, with strappy sandals and a wide‑brimmed hat.
Resort Dinner: Over a white slip dress, with gold hoops and heeled wedges.
Everyday Summer: Over a plain tank and linen shorts, with a crossbody bag.
As a Duster: Open and untied, over jeans and a knit top on a chilly evening.

Care:
Hand wash cold with mild detergent and flat dry in the shade.
Do not wring or hang — the weight of water can stretch the long knit.
Keep away from rough edges or jewellery that may snag the openwork pattern.

Der Pullover wird nahtlos von oben nach unten in Runden gestrickt. Man beginnt am Halsbündchen. An den vier Raglan-Linien werden dann jeweils Maschen zugenommen, so dass sich der Oberkörper formt. Paint a picture with yarn! The Sheep Jumper is a nostalgic statement piece, colours and textures blending to make a pastoral scene of sheep frolicking beside a fruit tree, with a country cottage in the distance, and a lone cloud in a summer sky. It is knitted using the intarsia technique, and even includes bobbles.

Cable cast on
Stocking Stitch/ Stockinette
1 x 1 rib
Knitting bobbles
Increasing in front and back of stitch, decreasing (k2tog)
Following a colourwork chart
Seaming stitches: Mattress, horizontal invisible stitch, backstitch
Binding off/casting off in 1 x 1 rib

With 6mm over stocking stitch/stockinette 14 sts x 19 rows = 10 x 10cm/4 x 4 ins

Any chunky/ bulky weight yarn, or aran/worsted weight yarns held double. In fact, any yarns that meet the tension/gauge stated with 6mm needles, or size to obtain tension/gauge.
5mm needles for rib, 6mm straight or a circular needle (60 or 80cm) for main.

Between 1000 - 1600m of chunky weight yarn

title: Hand-Knitted Merino Wool Chunky Cardigan, Pastel Oversized Knit, One-of-a-Kind UK Made
description:
🧶 THE WISTERIA CARDIGAN, KNITTED FOR YOU

Garden party elegance.
Pastel purple, pink and yellow. The softer side of winter.

Meet the Wisteria Cardigan, a one-of-a-kind hand-knitted piece made in the UK from 100% pure fine merino wool.

Soft, plush, and cloud-like, Wisteria is knitted in giant stitches with a dreamy pastel palette of lavender, lilac, blush pink, coral, soft mint, pale blue, creamy neutrals and gentle golden tones. It is colourful without being loud, and soft without ever feeling boring. The tones run through one roving rather than sitting in blocks, so the colour shifts along every row, as if every stitch had been painted by hand. No two come out the same.

Expect strangers to stop you and ask about it.

This cardigan makes a beautiful gift for a daughter, granddaughter, friend, mum, sister, or yourself. The palette is soft, flattering and easy to wear across ages and styles, and the shape sits just as well on men as on women.

KEY FEATURES
Hand-knitted by me in Worthing, England
100% pure fine merino wool
Non-mulesed merino, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified
Soft, warm, breathable and naturally odour-resistant
Relaxed oversized shape with dramatic chunky sleeves
A wool comb in every box
One of a kind, knitted to your size

🐑 THE WOOL
It isn't yarn. It's roving: wool carded but never spun, so it stays open and full of air. I split every length by hand and comb it straight before I knit it. That's the part a machine can't do, and it's why the stitches sit plump instead of flat.

Soft enough at the neck to wear with nothing underneath. Light for its size, because unspun wool is mostly air. Then heavy where you want it: two to three kilos of cardigan on your shoulders, like a blanket you're allowed to leave the house in.

Merino is naturally odour-resistant, so this isn't a garment that needs washing often. Air it overnight and it comes back fresh. Washing it less is the kindest thing you can do to wool this thick.

Non-mulesed merino, certified OEKO-TEX Standard 100, which means it has been tested for harmful substances against strict limits. In plain English, a wool you can squish, wear against skin and hand to someone you love.

📏 SIZES
Pick your size at checkout. Cropped sits at the high hip, Regular at the low hip.

It is designed oversized. Not sure? Message me with your usual size and I will tell you which to pick 💌

🧵 A WOOL COMB COMES IN EVERY BOX
Chunky wool pills for the first few wears, and the comb lifts them off. Two minutes, once or twice in the first month, and it settles. You would normally be left to find that out on your own. Here the fix is already in the box.

🚚 DELIVERY
• Knitted to order: dispatched in up to 15 working days, often less
• Then Royal Mail, tracked: around 2 to 3 working days in the UK, 7 to 10 working days internationally
• I message you the day it ships
• Cheaper cardigans exist abroad. So does import duty. Mine is knitted in Worthing, England, and posted from here

🧼 CARE
Air it between wears. That's usually all it needs. Hand wash cool when you have to, lay flat to dry, never tumble dry.

👋 A LITTLE ABOUT ME
I'm Fernando. From my studio in Worthing, on the South Coast, I make the chunky knitting tools, patterns and kits I couldn't find anywhere else. In a world getting more digital by the week, making a real, wearable thing with your hands is the opposite of that.

I'm Fernando. From my studio in Worthing, on the South Coast of the UK, I'm building Gigante Knits: the tools, patterns and kits for chunky knitting I couldn't find anywhere else. Knitting got me through a difficult stretch, and somewhere along the way I fell in love with how geometric and quietly mathematical it is. Ungefärbte und sehr warme Leggins aus 100% Yakwolle.
Diese Leggins ist perfekt für die kalten Wintertage, denn sie ist wärmend, isolierend und atmungsaktiv. Man kann sie sowohl zu Hause als auch im Freien mit anderen Kleidungsstücken kombinieren z.B. mit einem Rock, Kleid oder Pullover.


Meine Produkte werden in der Mongolei hergestellt. Da die mongolischen Yak in den bergigen Regionen leben, müssen sie mit extremen Wetterbedingungen zwischen 30°C bis-50°C zurechtkommen. 
Daher ist die Yakwolle wärmespeichernd, temperaturausgleichend und atmungsaktaktiv. Die bis zu 500 kg schweren Hornträger beeindrucken mit ihrem massigen Körper bei ruhigem und sozialem Gemüt. Pro Jahr kann ca. 300gr Haar aus einem Yak ausgekämmt und zu Yakgarn verarbeitet werden. Zudem ist Yakwolle ein Naturprodukt, dass sich umweltfreundlich gewinnen lässt und zu 100% ökologisch ist.

Die traditionelle Herdenhaltung in der Mongolei kommt ohne Stallhaltung aus. Das nomadische Leben ist auf die Herdentiere und dessen Wohlergehen angelegt. Die Wollen der Tiere werden nach dem Winter von den einzelnen Hirten ausgekämmt und zur weiteren Verarbeitung in die Webstuben transportiert.

title: Morphing Fractals Fire-Safe Sacred Geometry Leggings, Psychedelic Cotton Yoga Pants, Flow Arts Rave Clothing
description:
Move through transformation in our Morphing Fractals Leggings — a flowing sacred geometry design that shifts from bold honeycomb forms into intricate star-like patterns as it travels down the legs.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:

Our bleach-dyed collection is where Heady Made Apparel began, and after more than 10 years of refining the process, it remains our pride and joy.

Each pair is created one at a time using hand-drawn, hand-cut stencils, bleach, and an airbrush. We begin with ultra-soft, fire-safe leggings made from 92% ring-spun cotton and 8% spandex, then build the artwork in layers by hand to create depth and dimension.

A specialized triangular crotch gusset provides extra room and reinforcement where you need it most. By moving intersecting seams away from the center, it allows greater freedom of movement while helping reduce pressure, chafing, and uncomfortable bunching during stretching, dancing, squats, flow arts, and fire performance. The wide waistband and flexible cotton-rich fabric complete the supportive, body-contouring fit.

Every pair follows the same overall design layout, but subtle variations from the handcrafted process ensure that no two will ever be exactly alike. Each one is made with intention, care, and a little bit of our energy just for you.

We usually let the artwork speak for itself, but fair warning: these are the kind of leggings that get noticed. You may find yourself getting stopped for compliments more often than expected — and that’s a pretty good problem to have.

ORIGINAL ART BY HEADY MADE APPAREL:

The Morphing Fractals design represents transformation, connection, and the beauty found in constant change.

We hope these patterns serve as a reminder that we are all continuously growing and evolving while still remaining connected to where we began. As the geometry shifts from one form into the next, it reflects the way life moves through different stages — sometimes chaotic, sometimes beautifully aligned, but always connected.

Sacred geometry has long been associated with balance, harmony, meditation, and healing energy. Wearing these patterns can become a personal reminder to stay centered, move with intention, and remain open to growth even when the world around us feels overwhelming.

More than just a bold design, Morphing Fractals is a wearable representation of resilience, transformation, and our shared search for connection and meaning.

PRODUCT DETAILS:
Fire-safe 92% ring-spun cotton / 8% spandex blend
Premium triangular crotch gusset for flexibility, reinforcement, and reduced chafing or bunching
Wide waistband with a soft, supportive, body-contouring fit
Permanent hand bleach-dyed artwork — no cracking, peeling, or surface print to wear away
Hand-designed in the USA, with natural variations that make every pair unique
OUR MISSION:

Our intention is simple: to make the world a brighter and better place through art, color, and self-expression. We’ve seen firsthand how much of a positive impact art can have on a community — how it can shift the energy of a space, bring people together, inspire creativity, and add a little more beauty to everyday life. That belief is at the heart of Heady Made Apparel and everything we create.

Dieses luxuriöse Unikat überzeugt mit seinem besonders breiten Schnitt am Beinende und betont durch den Hüftsitz deine feminine Silhouette. Die natürliche Robustheit der hochwertigen Yakwolle sorgt für absolute Langlebigkeit und ein unvergleichliches Tragegefühl. Perfekt zum Relaxen zuhause, für gemütliche Stunden abends oder sogar für stilvolle Outdoor-Momente. Genieße die wohlige Wärme, einzigartige Weichheit und die nachhaltige Qualität.

Meine Produkte werden in der Mongolei hergestellt. Da die mongolischen Yak in den bergigen Regionen leben, müssen sie mit extremen Wetterbedingungen zwischen 30°C bis-50°C zurechtkommen. 
Daher ist die Yakwolle wärmespeichernd, temperaturausgleichend und atmungsaktaktiv. Die bis zu 500 kg schweren Hornträger beeindrucken mit ihrem massigen Körper bei ruhigem und sozialem Gemüt. Pro Jahr kann ca. 300gr Haar aus einem Yak ausgekämmt und zu Yakgarn verarbeitet werden. Zudem ist Yakwolle ein Naturprodukt, dass sich umweltfreundlich gewinnen lässt und zu 100% ökologisch ist.

Die traditionelle Herdenhaltung in der Mongolei kommt ohne Stallhaltung aus. Das nomadische Leben ist auf die Herdentiere und dessen Wohlergehen angelegt. Die Wollen der Tiere werden nach dem Winter von den einzelnen Hirten ausgekämmt und zur weiteren Verarbeitung in die Webstuben transportiert.

High-waisted Gothic leggings with a skull gate, winged guardian, cathedral architecture, and antique-gold detailing in a full all-over print. Designed as statement yoga pants for witchy outfits, alternative streetwear, festivals, and spooky-season styling.

WHY THIS PAIR COSTS MORE

• Full-coverage artwork mapped across both legs
• Skull gate and winged guardian composed on individual thighs
• Custom-cut and sewn construction
• All-over sublimation: the artwork becomes part of the fabric
• 80% polyester / 20% spandex performance blend
• Four-way stretch with a close, compression-style fit
• Soft 1.5-inch elastic waistband
• Made to order rather than pulled from pre-printed stock

THE NOCTURNE GATEKEEPERS ARTWORK

• Gilded skull gate on one front thigh
• Winged female guardian on the other front thigh
• Gothic cathedral windows and architectural tracery
• Black feathered wings wrapping toward the outer legs
• Antique-gold, bronze, charcoal and near-black palette
• Dark central seams that keep the major figures away from the center line

The artwork continues around the front, sides and back. Every viewing angle reveals another part of the same shadowed architectural world.

MATERIAL & FIT

• 80% polyester / 20% spandex
• Four-way stretch
• High-waisted, compression-style silhouette
• 1.5-inch elastic waistband
• Full all-over dye-sublimation print
• Ankle length
• Sizes XS–2XL
• Made in the USA using imported fabric
• Made to order

Please use the size guide in the gallery before ordering. These leggings are designed to fit close to the body.

MADE FOR

Goth clothes • Occult-inspired outfits • Witchy wardrobes • Halloween styling • Dark fantasy clothing • Alternative activewear • Yoga and light training • Concerts and festivals • Gothic streetwear • Cathedral and skull art

Pair them with a black crop top, oversized tee, Gothic hoodie, leather jacket, sneakers or combat boots. The design belongs naturally in a Halloween wardrobe, but it was created for year-round dark fashion.

HOW YOUR PAIR IS MADE

1. The two guardians are composed for a full-leg canvas.
2. The skull gate and winged guardian are positioned on individual thighs.
3. Sublimation transfers the artwork into the fabric.
4. Printed sections are cut and sewn into finished leggings.
5. The made-to-order pair is prepared for shipment.

Processing time is 1–3 days before carrier transit.

PRINT PLACEMENT

Because this is a cut-and-sew all-over-print garment made from stretch fabric, small placement variations near seams may occur. Individual details can also appear slightly different when the fabric stretches on the body. This is normal for all-over-print leggings and does not mean the print is defective.

CARE

• Machine wash on gentle cycle or hand wash cold
• Do not bleach
• Do not iron
• Do not dry clean
• Line dry recommended

COTTON CHAPTERS CO

Some chapters are quiet. Some are strange. Some belong in the dark.

Wear the chapter that feels like yours.
